hero.headline: A webinar that sells itself
hero.subheadline: One recording runs on its own, the chat talks with the room, and payment goes straight to the host. In Lithuanian, Russian, or English.
hero.note: Free to start · No card required

features.title: One recording. A live chat. Payment to the host.
features.subtitle: A sales room that keeps working when you are away from the screen.

items.title: Evergreen webinar
items.description: One recording runs at a set time, on chosen days, or when someone registers.

items.title: Automatic chat
items.description: Messages appear on the video timeline. A live conversation can become the script, and AI drafts it.

items.title: Payment to the host
items.description: The offer appears at a set minute. Attendees pay through your Paysera, Stripe, or PayPal account.

items.title: AI for slides and chat
items.description: Draft slide copy, an email, and the automatic chat script in one place.

items.title: Reminders in three languages
items.description: Messages before the event, when it has started, and after it ends. Lithuanian, English, or Russian.

items.title: Who watched and who paid
items.description: See registration, watch time, offer clicks, and payments.

steps.title: Upload the recording
steps.description: AI helps draft the chat script and the slide copy.

steps.title: Set the time
steps.description: An evergreen schedule or a live broadcast. Choose the audience language.

steps.title: Start the sale
steps.description: The room talks on its own, the offer appears on time, and the money goes to you.

cta.title: Launch a webinar that sells without you
cta.subtitle: One recording, a live chat, and payment to the host. Start free.

partners.title: Partner with NewWebinars
partners.subtitle: Earn 30% commission for the first 12 months by referring customers
partners.commissionDescription: For every customer you refer, earn commission on their payments for the first 12 months.
partners.termsConsentAfter: , including the ban on spam, bots, misleading, or other “grey-area” marketing.
partners.termsRequired: You must agree to the Partner Program Terms.
partners.applicationSuccess: Thank you, your application has been received. We will review it and contact you by email. Your referral link will become active only after approval.
partners.termsBody1: Partners may promote NewWebinars only through honest, lawful, and transparent methods. Sending unsolicited emails or messages, using bots, fake traffic, misleading advertising, impersonating NewWebinars, or promising unavailable discounts is prohibited.
partners.termsBody2: If these terms are breached, an application or partner account may be rejected or blocked, and unpaid commissions may be cancelled to the extent permitted by applicable law and the program terms.
